GenPage.clumping.note: Engine tuning should have its own separate overkill setting. Basically all these ones marked "overkill" for generator settings should go into an "advanced" dropdown that defaults closed rather than them being gated under the global overkill setting. That way people can muck about with them when they wanna go a bit further on one gen or another, instead of having to flip and stick with a top-level setting.

GenPage.pathTypeFold.note: ditto for the above, make sure these go into an "advanced" section, Maybe the advanced section can have collapsible sub-sections as well so its clean to view.
